info.title: ra-offline
info.author: cheasan
info.description: Offline RetroAchievements proxy sysmodule: keep earning achievements with no internet, auto-syncs when Wi-Fi returns.
info.details:
ra-offline is an Atmosphere sysmodule that acts as an offline loopback server for RetroAchievements.

While you play RetroArch without an internet connection, it pretends to be retroachievements.org on the Switch itself: game data is served from a local cache and every achievement you unlock is queued on the SD card. As soon as the Switch comes back online, the queued unlocks are replayed to the real retroachievements.org over TLS - automatically, and nothing is lost if the connection drops.

## Setup (required after install)

1. Pre-cache your games on a computer with the fetch-cache.py tool from the GitHub repo (needs your RetroAchievements account), then copy the resulting folder to sd:/switch/raoffline
2. Point RetroArch at the proxy: set cheevos_custom_host = "http://127.0.0.1:8080" in retroarch/retroarch.cfg (the ra-config.sh helper from the repo does this for you), then restart RetroArch
3. Reboot the console so the sysmodule starts

Games that are not in your cache simply show as having no achievements - cache more games any time with fetch-cache.py.

## Notes

- Requires Atmosphere CFW and the standard RetroArch Switch build
- The module logs to sd:/switch/raoffline/sysmodule.log for troubleshooting
- Uninstall: delete sd:/atmosphere/contents/4300000000000042 and remove the cheevos_custom_host line from retroarch.cfg

## Links

- Source and documentation: https://github.com/cheasan/switch-retro-offline
- Not affiliated with RetroAchievements.org, the RetroArch team, or Nintendo.
